title: Chapter 262 - 262 Puzzled; Gather!
content:
Chapter 262 - 262 Puzzled; Gather!

Chapter 262 - 262 Puzzled; Gather!

262 Puzzled; Gather!

Even though the stadium had ten side doors, there were 100,000 spectators for this concert! It would still take a long time for everyone to enter.

Song Yi swiped his ticket and went through a strict security check before finding his seat.

“I’m finally in.”

Next to him, a girl named Gao Lanwen, who scored about 80 points in appearance, looked at the dark shadows in the stadium and sighed, “There are too many people! I don’t know if Juan Juan and the others have come in.”

As she spoke, she could not help but look into the distance, trying to find her friends.

“Use this.” Song Yi took out the binoculars that he had prepared earlier and said.

“You even brought binoculars!” Gao Lanwen exclaimed in surprise.”

“This will allow us to see more clearly.” Song Yi smiled. “I remember Liu Juan and the others are in the 4,000+ seats in Zone E, right? It should be behind that direction…”

Gao Lanwen looked in the direction Song Yi was pointing at. Sure enough, she soon saw her friends. She could not help but wave and shout at them.

However, how could the other party hear her voice from such a distance?

Song Yi looked at Gao Lanwen’s cute face and was fascinated.

Then, he raised his head and looked into the distance as if he was looking for something, but he did not find anything.

“I don’t know where Ma Zhong and the others are. Forget it, I’ll just ask them.”

As he spoke, Song Yi took out his phone and quickly sent a message to the 104 Roommate group.

Song Yi: [Ma Zhong, have you entered the stadium?]

Ma Zhong: [We’re coming in.]

Zheng Jinbao: [Song Yi, do you know where we’re sitting? Our seats are VIP 196 and VIP 197, which are in the middle of the VIP area!]

Zheng Jinbao: [The chairs here are all real leather sofas. Can you believe it?]

Song Yi was speechless. [Really?]

Zheng Jinbao: [Do you think I’m lying?]

Then, Song Yi took the binoculars from Gao Lanwen and looked at the VIP area.

A chubby man with a round face waving his hand in his direction.

If this person was not Zheng Jinbao, then who was he?

Song Yi slowly put down his binoculars and said regretfully, “If I had known earlier, I would have asked Brother Lin Fan to help get me seats.”

…

At this moment, Gundong Entertainment’s music director, Zhao Peng, and deputy director, Zhang Xiaohai, also lined up to enter the stadium.

Zhang Xiaohai looked at the densely packed figures and said, “There are so many people!”

Zhao Peng said, “That’s normal. After all, WeChat, UA Browser, and Today’s Headlines have been promoting it for several days in a row. Plus, it’s free… If the venue was bigger, I wouldn’t be surprised even if the number of people is doubled.”

“Director Zhao, whose concert do you think this is?” Zhang Xiaohai asked.

“I don’t know.” Zhao Peng shook his head.

Then, he looked at his watch and frowned. “It’s almost eight o’clock. Why is it still dark around the stage?”

In fact…

Zhao Peng was not the only one who was puzzled. Many people in the audience had similar doubts.

The audience members in the stadium were still confused, while those who had only managed to grab standing tickets outside the stadium were a little irritated.

“What’s going on? The venue is black. Where’s the screen?”

“It’s fine if you don’t let me in, but there’s no display screen either?”

“If I had known earlier, I wouldn’t have come.”

…

While everyone was still confused and discussing, a helicopter quietly stopped beside the stadium.

After Lin Fan, Xia Bing, and Xia Xue got off the plane, they went straight to VIP 1 at the front of the stadium.

Hu Tian, Chu Yunyue, Qiu Ziqian, Huang Ling, Han Tian, Song Jiaxin, and the others were all there.

When they caught sight of Lin Fan, their faces lit up.

“You guys are finally here. I thought you were going to be late.”

“You’re Xia Bing and Xia Xue, right? You’re really cute.”

“Sit down, sit down.”

Xia Bing and Xia Xue were very introverted. Originally, they were a little shy when they saw so many people.

However, after being warmly greeted by them, they finally calmed down.

Looking at the relaxed and harmonious expressions of the girls, Lin Fan heaved a sigh of relief.

In fact…

He had also gone through a mental struggle at the thought of letting the girls meet.

All the girls knew that Lin Fan had other women.

However, they had never met each other before.

Lin Fan did not know what would happen if they really met.

However… he had to face this sooner or later.

After all, there was still a long way to go.

Lin Fan could not separate everyone into different worlds.

Therefore, he finally took this opportunity to let them meet first.

From the looks of it, the situation was not bad.

Lin Fan scanned the women, and when he saw Song Jiaxin, he could not help but use his Eyes of Truth.

[Appearance: 95]

[Favorability: 89.5]

Seeing this…

Lin Fan was stunned.

89.5?

What was going on?

Favorability?

Song Jiaxin’s favorability toward him last time seemed to be 89.

It had increased?

Tan Shengyu, who was sitting at the back, looked at the row of beauties sitting around Lin Fan and praised sincerely, “As expected of Brother Lin Fan!”

“Is that even necessary to say?” Liu Yuhang said.

Sun Luguo, who was sitting next to him, looked at his watch and said, “It’s almost eight o’clock. Why is the stage still dark?”

“Don’t tell me it’s not ready yet?” Zhang Bin asked.

Just as they were wondering, a soft sound suddenly appeared on the stage, attracting everyone’s attention.
